People's Leasing income grows 27% 📈

People's Leasing & Finance PLC (PLC) earned total operating income of Rs 9.95 billion in the July to September 2026 quarter, up 27% from a year ago. Net interest income rose 30% to Rs 7.72 billion.

Profit for shareholders was Rs 1.42 billion, up 1% on a year ago and 6% on the last quarter. For the first six months, profit was Rs 2.75 billion, up 7%. Loan impairment charges were higher, at Rs 1.11 billion.

Source: PLC interim financial statements, Colombo Stock Exchange, https://cdn.cse.lk/cmt/upload_report_file/1103_1794568299096.pdf
